title: Viera 15: a fully furnished family home on the edge of Shah Alam's CBD.
excerpt: A leasehold block of 479 units beside Toyota's service centre in Seksyen 15, sold fully fitted from about RM400,000. Sean likes the maturity, the facilities and the four-sided corner units, but not the approach or the investment pull.
takeaways: Units from 550 to 808 sq ft, fully fitted, starting from about RM400,000.
A 48 m family pool, a rooftop deck and two parking bays per unit, rare on this side of Shah Alam.
Reached past old shop lots and a service centre, near the Dato' Menteri LRT but not linked to it.

sections.heading: What sets it apart
paragraphs: Viera 15 is a leasehold mixed development of 479 units over 14 shop lots, with every unit given two side-by-side parking bays. The level-seven deck is designed for families: a 48 m free-form pool with a shallow shelf and jacuzzi, a kids' pool with a little pavilion, a playground, urban farming plots, a gym facing the pool, a co-working space set on a bio-pond and a multipurpose hall, plus a rooftop garden with barbecue terraces. A kindergarten and EV charging sit at ground level.

Each floor has 16 units served by four lifts. Units run from 550 sq ft to 808 sq ft, and come fitted with kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, a three-burner hob and air conditioners. Sean viewed the 808 sq ft three-bedroom corner unit with a 3 m ceiling, a 3.2 m-wide living area, no yard, and windows on four sides, including a small flexi room.

sections.heading: Where it is
paragraphs: The site sits in Seksyen 15 beside the Federal Highway and a Toyota service centre, among light-industrial and logistics sites, with old shop lots and a convention centre nearby. Shah Alam's CBD, with bank headquarters, government offices, a mall, a park, hospitals and universities, is about five minutes away across the LKSA highway. The developer will run a shuttle to the Dato' Menteri LRT station, the KTM station is nearby, and the Federal Highway and KESAS lead to Subang, Klang and Kota Kemuning.

sections.heading: Rent and returns
paragraphs: Prices start from about RM400,000, varying with size, floor and orientation, and units come fully furnished. Sean sees it mainly as an own-stay home rather than an investment.

standout.title: Semi-detached units with four open sides
standout.body: Rather than pocket-like voids off the corridor, units are paired like semi-detached homes with a gap between them. That gives each unit an extra facade for the small bedroom and bathroom windows, and the corner unit Sean viewed has openings on four sides.

pros: The location is mature: Shah Alam's CBD with its offices, mall, convention centre, parks, schools and universities is across the highway, and the LKSA and Federal Highway reach Subang, Sunway, Klang and Kota Kemuning.

A refined design approach: organic, family-oriented facilities that soften the industrial surroundings, close to what the developer delivered before, plus a rare rooftop deck for this part of Shah Alam.
The unit and density: paired units with extra windows, a corner unit open on four sides, large windows, full fitting-out with solid carpentry, and a low-density area surrounded by greenery.
cons: The approach: you drive past old shop lots, an old building and the service centre, and lower floors facing the roundabout will see a lot of traffic. The nearby commercial areas are quiet beyond the front rows, and the LRT is not directly connected.
Shah Alam isn't an obvious investment location, so it suits own-stay buyers who know the area, such as families of nearby landed homeowners.
The shop lots face outward at the back, which seems out of place and matters mainly to anyone buying a commercial unit.

closing: A well-priced, fully furnished family home for people whose work is around Shah Alam's industrial and business areas.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's full English captions for this September 2025 episode and its video description. The 3 on 3 follows the three things he likes and the three he doesn't, in his order, at the end of the video. The developer's team showed Sean the sales gallery, model and show unit; prices are theirs, and furnishing is as shown, so buyers should confirm specifications. Sean grew up in Shah Alam.
